review.rationale: Recommendation strictly binds execution to the frozen PR #27 candidate (base ccf473f3, head e6a193f4, expected tree 9171e554), mandates a preflight re-verification that halts on any drift, gates Draft-to-ready conversion as a single non-retryable mutation with explicit partial-mutation recording, and enforces a plain merge commit via gh pr merge --merge with --match-head-commit while explicitly prohibiting --admin, --auto, --delete-branch, --squash, and --rebase. Structural post-merge checks require exact parents, tree, and PR closure while preserving the candidate branch. Isolated post-merge validation reruns schema, dependency, site, release, and CE tests in a disposable worktree, and any failure is fail-closed with no reset, force-push, deletion, or automatic revert—requiring a separate remediation Decision. Zero GitHub checks are accepted only as a bounded exact-candidate absence supplemented by R2 and semantic-review evidence, explicitly not as CI success or general policy. Authority boundaries are preserved: the Recommendation does not authorize mutation, merge, release, or deployment and requires a separate Human Decision and qwen3.7-max Decision review. Options B–E are correctly rejected or not recommended, aligning with the governance contract.
